file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx"

diesel_idx = df.index[df['Number'] == 'Diesel'][0]
steam_df = df.iloc[steam_idx+1:diesel_idx]

arrangements = steam_df['Type/Wheel Configuration'].dropna().tolist()
